# Page sources behind stored documents that were kept as tag-stripped one-line text

Personal use only, not for distribution or resale; not for navigation.

Fetched on 2026-09-25 from Ryan's desktop with plain GETs; `sources.json` has each URL and the
Content-Type the server sent. These are what `/research/proxy-download-batch`'s Scrape.do fallback
receives before `html.replace(/<[^>]+>/g, ' ').replace(/\s+/g, ' ')` (Worker/research/download.js).
Byte-exact: `.gitattributes` here stops git from touching line endings.

| File | Stored copy today |
|---|---|
| scdnr-news-freshwater.html | 16,015 chars on one line, starting with the Google Tag Manager script |
| edgefield-advertiser-scdnr-report-2012-08.html | 24,367 chars on one line, starting with WordPress CSS and `&#8211;` |
| lakegreenwoodfishing-report-2026-09-06.html | 38,070 chars on one line, starting with a JSON-LD block |
| ncwrc-inland-fishing-regulations.pdf.head | the first 8,192 bytes of a 272,304-byte `application/pdf`; stored today as 212,503 characters of PDF bytes |
